Outcome and scope

A reference-matched layout with the full source above two clean square output previews compares the previous largest centered square crop (dashed orange) with a caption-preserving BestCrop square (solid red). As-is and To-be labels sit above the respective 360x360 previews. Both crop boxes and output previews share one photograph-and-title source; overlay lines appear only on the large source view. The photo is by Rima Kruciene (Unsplash License); the editorial title BREW BETTER COFFEE is added for demonstration. The asset is integrated into the existing BestCrop work-project entry. The final user reference added the full-source-over-two-crops arrangement. Dashed orange denotes As-is; solid red denotes To-be.

The user refined the initial three-panel plan to a single source image with overlaid boxes. The follow-up requested an actual image, so the vector scene was replaced with a real photograph. A further refinement uses a coffee photograph with a title whose first letters are clearly truncated by the center crop. Both final squares are 800x800; only the position changes, by 180 pixels to the left. The photograph is real; caption and boxes are illustrative, not actual model predictions or benchmarks. The user subsequently confirmed TensorFlow, PyTorch, TensorRT and Triton. All four now populate the BestCrop skills array; TensorFlow/PyTorch reuse existing assets and TensorRT/Triton use new local SVG name badges.
